questions.question: The average age of 17 persons is 39 years. If the average age of the first 9 persons is 35 years, and the average age of the last 9 persons is 44 years, what is the age of the 9 th person?
questions.questionHtml: The average age of 17 persons is 39 years. If the average age of the first 9 persons is 35 years, and the average age of the last 9 persons is 44 years, what is the age of the 9<sup>th</sup> person?
questions.solution:
We know that

Average age = Total age of all persons ÷ total persons

So,

Total age of all persons = Average age × total persons

Given:

1) Average age of 17 persons is 39 years.

Total age of all persons = Average age × total persons

= 39 × 17

= 663

2) Average age of the first 9 persons is 35 years.

Total age of the first 9 persons = Average age × total persons

= 35 × 9

= 315

3) Average age of the last 9 persons is 44 years.

Total age of the last 9 persons = Average age × total persons

= 44 × 9

= 396

So,

The age of the 9th person = Total age of the first 9 persons + Total age of the last 9 persons - Total age of all persons  

= 315 + 396 – 663

= 711 – 663

= 48

Hence, the age of the 9th person is ‘48’.

questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the equation. 252 * 14 * 8 * 100 * 16 * 60
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the equation.

252 * 14 * 8 * 100 * 16 * 60
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule:

Given equation 252 * 14 * 8 * 100 * 16 * 60

Option 1: Using the combination ÷, ×, +, =, - 

252 ÷ 14 × 8 + 100 = 16 - 60 

By BODMAS rule

252 ÷ 14 × 8 + 100 = 16 - 60 

18 × 8 + 100 = 16 - 60 

144 + 100 = 16 - 60 

244 = - 44 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2: Using combination ÷, -, ×, +, =

252 ÷ 14 - 8 × 100 + 16 = 60

18 - 8 × 100 + 16 = 60

18 - 800 + 16 = 60

18 - 800 + 16 = 60

34 – 800 = 60

- 766 = 60 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3: Using the combination ÷, ×, -, +, =

252 ÷ 14 × 8 - 100 + 16 = 60

18 × 8 - 100 + 16 = 60

144 - 100 + 16 = 60

160 – 100 = 60

60 = 60 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4: Using the combination ÷, ×, +, -, =

252 ÷ 14 × 8 + 100 - 16 = 60

18 × 8 + 100 - 16 = 60

144 + 100 - 16 = 60

244 - 16 = 60

228 = 60 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, the answer is “÷, ×, -, +, =”.

    • Some specific issues include the costs and benefits of alternative environmental policies to combat air pollution, water quality, solid waste, and global warming.

Additional Information

    • it is a branch of economics that focuses on improving fiscal, economic, and social conditions in developing countries.

    • It is concerned with all those economic deals which are done outside the borders of the country.​

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Continental crust.

Key Points

  • Continental crust is made of light rocks like granite. 
    • It is thick and high above sea level. like Eurasian and Antarctic Plate.

Additional Information

  •  Oceanic plate:
    • They have more weight and less thickness.
    • It is formed by basalt consisting of the ocean floor. such as the Pacific Ocean Plate.
  • ​The inner part of the earth is divided into three parts -​
    • ​The Crust
      • This is the outside layer of the earth and is made of solid rock, mostly basalt and granite.
      • There are two types of a crust; oceanic and continental. Oceanic crust is denser and thinner and mainly composed of basalt. It is also known as Sima (most abundant minerals being silicate and magnesium)
      • Continental crust is less dense, thicker, and mainly composed of granite. It is also called Sial (the most abundant minerals being silicate and aluminum).
    • The Mantle
      • The portion of the interior beyond the crust is called the mantle. The mantle extends from Moho’s discontinuity (the boundary between the crust and mantle) to a depth of 2,900 km.
      • The crust and the uppermost part of the mantle are called the lithosphere. Its thickness ranges from 10-200 km.
      • The upper portion of the mantle is called the asthenosphere which is the main source of magma that finds its way to the surface during volcanic eruptions.
      • The lower mantle extends beyond the asthenosphere. It is in solid-state.
    • The Core
      • The mantle-core boundary (Gutenberg discontinuity) is located at a depth of 2,900 km.
      • The outer core is in a liquid state while the inner core is in a solid-state.
      • The core is made up of very heavy material mostly constituted by nickel and iron. Thus, it is sometimes referred to as the nife layer.

Key Points

  • Wavelength -
    • It is a measure of the distance between two equal peaks of a crest or trough.
    • It is denoted by the Greek letter 'lambda' (λ). Its SI unit is a 'Meter'.
    • There is a relationship between the wavelength (λ), the velocity (v) of the wave, and the frequency (f) of a wave.
    • λ = v / f

Additional Information

  • Transverse Waves -
    • The mechanical wave which, when transmitted, vibrates perpendicular to the direction of propagation of the particle of the medium, is called a transverse wave.
    • Transverse waves can only be produced in solids.
    • These waves cannot be produced inside liquids.
    • It can be produced only on the surface of the liquid.
  • Longitudinal Wave -
    • If the particles of the medium oscillate back and forth at their mean position in the direction of propagation of the wave, then such waves produced are called longitudinal waves. Like sound waves.
    • Longitudinal waves can be produced in all mediums (solids, liquids, gases).
    • Sound waves in the air, earthquake waves, and spring waves are also longitudinal waves.​
  • Electromagnetic or mechanical wave -
    • Waves that do not require any medium for propagation.
    • That is, these waves can also propagate in a vacuum.
  •  Mechanical Waves -
    • The disturbance produced by throwing bricks in the water of a calm river or pond is called a mechanical wave.
    • For mechanical waves to propagate through a medium, it is necessary that the medium has the properties of elasticity or inertia.

questions.questionHtml: In ΔABC, D is a point on BC such that ∠BAD = \(\frac{1}{2}\)∠ADC and ∠BAC = 77° and ∠C = 45°. What is the measure of ∠ADB ?
questions.solution:
Given:

∠BAD = 1/2∠ADC

∠BAC = 77° 

∠C = 45° 

Concept used:

The exterior angle theorem: It states that if a triangle's side is extended, then the resultant exterior angle would be equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles of the triangle.

Angle sum property: Sum of all the three angles of a triangle is 180°.

Calculation:

In ΔABC,

∠BAC + ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180° [Angle sum property]

⇒ 77° + ∠ABC + 45° = 180° 

⇒ 122° + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABC = (180° – 122°)

⇒ ∠ABC = 58° 

In ΔBAD,

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠BAD = ∠ADC  [Exterior angle theorem] 

⇒ 58° + ∠BAD = 2∠ADC

⇒ ∠BAD = 58° 

In ΔBAD,

⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BAD + ∠ADB = 180° [Angle sum property]

⇒ 58° + 58° + ∠ADB = 180° 

⇒ 116° + ∠ADB = 180° 

⇒ ∠ADB = (180° – 116°)

⇒ ∠ADB = 64° 

∴ The required value of ∠ADB is 64°

Midpoint theorem: The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of two sides of the triangle is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

The area(ADEC) = area(ΔBAC – ΔBDE)

Value of 3x2 = 3 × 8 = 24

Given:

The six digit number = 5z3x4y

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of  7 - The difference between twice the unit digit of the given number and the remaining part of the given number should be a multiple of 7 or it should be equal to 0.

Divisibility rule of 11 - If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equals 0 or divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

Divisibility rule of 13 -  A number is divisible by 13 when the ones place digit of a number is multiplied by 4 and the product is added to the rest of the number either gives 0 or a multiple of 13.

7 × 11 × 13 = 1001, when any three digit number multiplied by 1001 then it repeats itself and always completely divisible by 7, 11 and 13.

Calculation:

Let 3 digit number be pqr

⇒ pqr × 1001 = 5z3x4y

⇒ pqrpqr = 5z3x4y

compare both sides
